seasonRows.notes: MU 7-43 is not listed in the Region 7B sharp tailed grouse rows (my reading of the table).

plan: Drive: from District of Hudsons Hope, about 116 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 56.55591, -123.10246, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk 5.2 km to the start. Walk: the unnamed road stretch, 5.8 km one way. About 115 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-43, Region 7B. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-05, closures 2026-10-16.
